mapper.sql: id, username, display_name, email, password_hash, bio, avatar_key, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO users (username, display_name, email, password_hash, bio, avatar_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{bio}, #{avatarKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) RETURNING id
SELECT FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email})
SELECT FROM users WHERE lower(username) = lower(#{username})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE lower(username) = lower(#{username}))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email}))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = #{id})
UPDATE users SET display_name = #{displayName}, bio = #{bio}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} RETURNING
UPDATE users SET avatar_key = #{key}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} RETURNING id AS user_id, OLD.avatar_key AS old_key
SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT i.object_key FROM post_images i JOIN posts p ON p.id = i.post_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT avatar_key FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} AND avatar_key IS NOT NULL
